title: When someone pays online while joining, the gym gets no 'paid online' alert, and the saved request still says they pay at the desk
what: Pay online on the join page is live. When a member pays a fee or a shop order online, the admin app gets an alert saying who paid and to look at Money. A person who pays online while joining gets no such alert: the minute job reads the payment but throws it away because it is a join payment. The only alert the gym gets is the earlier one, made when the request was sent and before any payment, and the request saved on the gym server says 'Pays at the desk'. Staff who do not open Today can ask the person to pay again at the desk.
expected: A payment made online on the join page gives the same 'paid online' alert as fee and shop payments, and nothing saved with the request says they will pay at the desk once they have paid.
who: gym owners and desk staff, people who join online
fix_line: Let the paid-online alert take join payments too, saying the person paid while joining and pointing to Today

title: HQ shows a trial gym's AI Assistant limit as 50 a day while it really gets 20, and saving only the minutes raises it to 50
what: A gym in its free trial or not paid gets 20 AI Assistant requests a day. HQ's gym page fills the requests box with 50 for every gym that has no limit of its own, so for a trial gym it shows a number that is not true. If the owner changes only the spoken minutes and taps Save, the 50 in the box is saved as the gym's own limit, and the trial gym now gets 50 requests a day, more than a trial is meant to cost.
expected: HQ shows the limit the gym really has today (20 for a trial or unpaid gym), and changing the minutes leaves the requests as they were.
who: the owner in HQ, trial gyms
how_often: every trial gym's page; every save of minutes only
fix_line: Show the trial number for trial gyms, and save only the part that was changed

title: HQ's AI cost for a gym's day is priced by whichever AI answered last that day
what: Column matching keeps one usage line per gym a day. Every call adds its tokens to that line and overwrites which AI answered, and a failed call blanks it. HQ then prices all of the day's tokens at the price of that last AI, or at the Gemini price when the last call failed. A day where Claude and Gemini both answered shows a cost that is wrong either way, and the dearer backup Gemini models are priced like the cheapest one.
expected: Each call's tokens are priced by the AI that used them, so the gym list, the gym page and the System page show the real rough cost.
who: the owner reading AI cost in HQ
how_often: days when more than one AI answered or the last call failed
fix_line: Keep tokens per AI (one usage line per AI a day) and price each line by its own AI

items.reason: HQ and the gate Worker have no import or undo-import; AI import lives in the panel Worker
